title: Opening Inventory Recovery Under Workplace Cafe Management Program Commercial Terms
content:
The opening inventory recovery borne on the closure of a Workplace Cafe Management Program contract turns on how long the cafe has been serving on the day the settlement is worked out and on whether a day of written notice of termination stands on the contract.

## The recovery bands

Where the cafe has been serving for fewer than twelve whole months on the day the settlement is worked out and a day of written notice of termination stands on the contract, the opening inventory recovery is the early inventory recovery share of the opening inventory printed against the service model, rounded to the nearest cent.

Where the cafe has been serving for twelve whole months or more but fewer than twenty-four on that day and a day of written notice of termination stands on the contract, the opening inventory recovery is the part inventory recovery share of that opening inventory, rounded to the nearest cent.

Otherwise the opening inventory recovery is nil; where the cafe has been serving for twenty-four whole months or more, that is so.

## The shares in figures

The early inventory recovery share is 100 per cent. The part inventory recovery share is 50 per cent. Each is taken on the opening inventory printed against the service model, and the figure that results is rounded to the nearest cent.

## Where the bands divide

Whole months in service are counted to the day the settlement is worked out. A cafe that has been serving for exactly 12 whole months on that day sits in the second band and not in the first, since the first band asks for fewer than 12 whole months. A cafe serving for exactly 24 whole months on that day sits in neither band, since the second band asks for fewer than 24. Where no day of written notice of termination stands on the contract, neither of the first two bands is answered and no opening inventory recovery is taken.

## Worked on hypothetical figures

Taking a hypothetical opening inventory of 12600.00 USD printed against the service model, a cafe serving for 9 whole months with a day of written notice of termination standing carries an opening inventory recovery of 12600.00 USD, and a cafe serving for 15 whole months on the same hypothetical inventory carries 6300.00 USD, each rounded to the nearest cent. The inventory amount used here is hypothetical.
